text: Let me start by asking: Can you point to the exact spot where it hurts, and does the pain get worse when you walk or jump? Also, have you noticed any swelling or redness in that area?

text: 7-year-old male. Mother has noticed a change in the child’s play patterns, specifically favoring his left leg while walking or running. speaker: Doctor
text: That is very helpful; the fact that he points to the knee rather than the hip is a crucial clue, but hip pathology often refers pain to the knee. Does he experience any pain or stiffness in the morning, or does it improve after a few minutes of activity? Also, has he been complaining of hip pain when you get up from sitting or climbing stairs?
